cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: For the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to state exactly what they did, knew, or authorized before you reveal your own involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I show you my dinner invitations, who did you authorize your sister to bring? Be specific, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A date. Did you invite my ex?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First, name any exclusions you gave her. We can't compare my list with an incomplete instruction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My ex was excluded. I sent you both the same message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then read me the timestamp on my copy. Recipients and times separately, please; I'll show my invitation once we've established when I was told.

reason: Make A's precise recipient/time procedure depend on B's actual shared-message claim, preserving delayed disclosure.
